items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: they showed me a guard, a fellow they called "Train". His name was Colger.

ctx.x: Well, I was still doing the Lennie's Temple. They had, the word got out about music for me there. And, I was in the gymnasium putting on football togs to go out and go for the football team. So, when I got out there, they said no. You go to the band room. I was weighing about 165 lbs., I suppose. I said no. I want to play football. And, I insisted on playing football. I said I'll go to the band room later. But, I want to play football.

But, they found out about my music. They wanted me there instead. So, they said, they showed me a guard, a fellow they called "Train". His name was Colger. He weighed about 350 lbs. They said okay. You want to play
football. They didn't have grass out on the turf like they have now. That was dirt. Rocks. They said if you can tackle him, you can stay out here to play football.
